description: Strands Agents SDK guidance for building AI agents in Python and TypeScript: agent loop, tools and MCP, multi-agent orchestration, sessions and memory, model portability, streaming, and structured output. Includes a skill for when and how to use Strands and how to add it to an existing FastAPI, Express, or Next.js app.

interface.longDescription: Strands Agents is an open-source SDK (started at AWS, now community-governed under the strands-agents GitHub org) for building AI agents in Python and TypeScript. This plugin provides a skill that guides when to choose Strands — agent loop with lifecycle hooks, tools and MCP, multi-agent orchestration (graph/swarm), sessions and memory, model portability (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and more), streaming, structured output, observability — and how to install and wire it into an existing FastAPI, Express, or Next.js app, with copy-pasteable integration recipes in the skill references.
interface.shortDescription: Build AI agents with the Strands Agents SDK

name: strands-agents
